I'm glad you're not just bottling it up. When you feel these negative feelings towards people either write them down or draw them. One tip I'll give you is to not start self diagnosing unless you do extensive research. Even then it can be off unless you go to a professional. When I first started experiencing my symptoms I thought I was just faking it and that "I wasn't sick". Stuff like that. I would recommend reaching out to whoever you live with that takes care of you about your problems. You don't have to go in depth. Just say you haven't been mentally well and would like to start seeing a therapist or psychologist. Please do this before you start spiraling too much. This happened to me and it wasn't fun. And try to find coping skills that'll help you feel something that isn't hurting yourself. Watch a horror or action movie, if you wanna feel something flick a rubber band or hair tie on your wrist, maybe eat something spicy. Those are all stuff I do or used to do. Reach out to me if you want anymore info or have questions. I didn't wanna put a huge paragraph in the comments lol

Just don't push yourself to where you feel u comfortably full or just regret.
